html:
Constantin Brâncuși was a sculptor, born in 1876 in the village of Hobița in Gorj county, whose simple, polished forms made him one of the founders of modern sculpture.

He walked much of the way from Romania to Paris, arriving in 1904, and left Rodin's studio after a short time, saying nothing grows in the shadow of great trees. He carved directly in stone and wood and reduced subjects to pure shapes, as in The Kiss, Sleeping Muse and the Bird in Space series. In 1928 a United States court ruled that Bird in Space was art and not taxable metal. In 1938 he finished a war memorial at Târgu Jiu in Romania, with the Endless Column, the Gate of the Kiss and the Table of Silence. He died in Paris, where his studio is kept.
sum: Constantin Brâncuși was a sculptor, born in 1876 in the village of Hobița in Gorj county, whose simple, polished forms made him one of the founders of modern sculpture.
